# Knowledge

Durable learnings captured from sessions — gotchas, conventions, constraints, and hard-won debugging insights. Grouped by topic, newest first within each topic.

Use `/rota-learn` at the end of a session to capture new learnings. `/rota-work` consults this file when its topics are relevant to the task.

_(no terms yet — use `/rota-learn --term <name>` to capture project terminology)_
empty..rota/MAP.md:
# Project map

AI-facing index of subsystems. Detail files live in `.rota/map/<name>.md` and are loaded on demand via `.rota/bin/hv-map-query <name>`. The thin always-on summary in `CLAUDE.md` is regenerated by `.rota/bin/hv-map-index`.

Write `.rota/map/<name>.md` files describing subsystems as you discover them. Cycle skills (`/rota-work`, `/rota-debug`, `/hv-go`) bump `touched:` post-cycle on subsystems whose key files or entry points overlap the cycle's changes.
